_doc: The capability issuance roster. Doctrine: .claude/skills/cut/references/capability_port.md. Join: go run ./tools/agentctl verify (and go test ./...). Every command a CLI dispatches MUST appear here with an honest disposition, and every row here must dispatch. An unnamed capability is a capability nobody owns. The Python application (src/philocr/main.py) is not a dispatched CLI and has no row here.

_dispositions.issued: a typed port exists that consumers hold; name it in `port` and the file that owns it in `driver`
_dispositions.instrument: the runner is live and no port is issued yet — honesty, not failure
_dispositions.remainder: still advertised but outside the CLI spine (a script, another language)
_dispositions.retired-stub: kept only to refuse, and to tell the caller where the capability went

clis.note: the agent-surface toolchain that travels with this repository. The OCR application is Python and is not this CLI.
